policy: Frozen v8 hyperparameters and v5 trading thresholds. Fit each fold once at its start on trailing730 days, labels fully mature before8-day embargo. Candidate-mean control has no market features. No threshold, sizing or direction sweep.
clock: Existing v4 immutable examples use source-offset legacy clock; verify every decision matches explicit UTC anchor1970-01-01T00:04:59.999Z on6h grid. Do not regenerate or silently realign examples.
advance_rule: Model must have positive normal and stress net in at least6 of8 folds, no fold DD>20% in any normal/fee/execution scenario, >=30 total fills and higher mean fold net than candidate-mean control. This is a research screen only, not independent validation or live approval.
data_status: All dates are development after earlier experiments; April-July2026 reserve already opened but not used in this trial. No new independent test is claimed.
